title: Freeze the complete single-path SDK and Gallery candidate
requires: Clean candidate freeze environment and all single-path integration tasks merged
scope: Replace the interim rigid-only candidates with one exact all-supported-domain, single-schedule public SDK/Gallery candidate before final F8 device qualification. Follow docs/roadmap/F8-SINGLE-EXECUTION-PATH.md. Mandatory dispatch reduction requirements are defined in docs/roadmap/F8-DISPATCH-REDUCTION.md.
acceptance: Audit installed public creation/step and Gallery paths for all baseline supported domains/interactions and auxiliary features; fail on any remaining legacy choice, blanket integration rejection or private-test-only coverage.

Freeze source, API/ABI, kernel/adapter/runtime/oracle/contract, workload, independent dispatch/work ceilings and application artifact identities after F8-39--51 and F8-54--56; preserve interim candidate records as historical evidence without rewriting their hashes.

Through a coordination PR, route unleased F8-24--30 and F8-53 cards to the exact new candidate before they are claimed; their F8-52 dependency remains in place. Preserve completed F8-23 interim qualification and its evidence; F8-53 supplies final CPU/public-contract requalification. Completion cannot redefine other cards or active leases.

Candidate validation rejects protected drift and evidence union across revisions. Retain independent oracles and unchanged workload/quality/performance gates; collect installed-consumer preflight evidence.
Device/API capability manifests accurately retain the baseline supported surface; missing runtime work must create a prerequisite repair task rather than shrinking the qualification matrix.

Reject the freeze until F8-54 Metal batching, F8-55 common-BVH coupling searches/batching and F8-56 independent native/Gallery reduction evidence are merged done. A runtime-derived budget, one spatial-build counter, compile-only result or absent Apple-device run cannot satisfy this gate.
